renderingSemantics.stale_document: usable document with an out-of-window document date
renderingSemantics.ytd_income_mismatch: usable documents whose extracted income differs from keyed system data
renderingSemantics.pay_frequency_mismatch: usable salary slip whose visible frequency differs from keyed system data
renderingSemantics.pay_period_mismatch: usable salary slip whose visible pay-period end differs from keyed system data
renderingSemantics.mislabeled_document: usable rendered salary slip whose learner-visible upload index declares bank_statement

tatClock.note: For this synthetic lab, one business day is represented as 24 continuous elapsed hours so kickbacks cannot hide time through clock resets. Production business-calendar reporting remains a separate observed shadow-run view.

routeSemantics.note: A route requests the next human review stage; it never makes a lending decision.

metrics.fieldExtractionAccuracy: correct extracted monthly-income and pay-frequency fields / all contracted extraction fields; scored against assessor-only document truth
metrics.firstPassYield: applications routed to the correct next stage without a later kickback / all applications; scored against assessor-only route truth
metrics.processorTouches: prototype uses one bounded intake touch per application; baseline comparator is assessor-only workflow truth
metrics.processorReviewTimeMinutes: processor_review_completed.at - processor_review_started.at in minutes; compare observed prototype events to assessor-only baseline workflow truth
metrics.falseClearRate: processor-review truth predicted as underwriting / processor-review truth
metrics.falseFlagRate: underwriting truth predicted as processor-review / underwriting truth
metrics.postPrototypeKickbackRate: review-required applications incorrectly cleared to underwriting / all applications
metrics.validationRecall: review-required applications routed to processor-review / all actual review-required applications, reported by issue class

warning: Synthetic coverage validates workflow mechanics only. TAT, touch-count and post-prototype kickback targets are evaluated only from observed shadow-run events; this dataset does not assume or claim those improvements.
